videos.title: What Happens When a Tsunami Hits? (3D) 🌊
videos.description:
In deep water a tsunami is fast but less than a meter tall. Near the coast it slows down and grows, the sea pulls back first, then a wall of water rushes in. If the sea suddenly pulls back, run to high ground.
Did you know the sea pulls back first? 👇
